[[Gandle Ott]]'s '''planetary militia''' was responsible for the security of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], it was commanded by [[General/Legends|general]] [[Herron Dade]].
